task: ae.vfs in-memory POSIX-like filesystem (inodes, symlinks, permissions, quota, snapshots, fsck)
reasoning_summary: Designed an inode tree with a single path-walk routine (symlink expansion queue, hop limit, per-directory search permission) reused by every operation. Wrote the unit tests and a seeded differential test against a naive path-map model first. All 17 tests passed on the first run; mutation checks on five rules each made a test fail.
